title: Civil rights lawyer Ben Crump releases data from Nolan Wells’ cellphone
summary_full: Messaging ‘very telling’, says Crump after grand jury said it found no evidence of criminal conduct in teen’s deathCivil rights attorney Ben Crump released information from a forensic examination of Nolan Wells’ cellphone as well as details of the official autopsy on Thursday, just days after a Mississippi grand jury said it found no evidence of criminal conduct in the teen’s death.Attorneys representing the 18-year-old Black college student’s family have called for transparency, asking that the grand jury investigative materials and the official autopsy report be publicly released.
